summary.en-GB: An add-on that intercepts links that create new Google Calendar events and turns them into iCalendar (ICS) files you can import in your favorite calendar application (Thunderbird, Outlook, Proton Calendar, etc.)

release_notes.en-GB:
Drop support for Firefox versions lower than 126, including ESR 115 (which is no longer supported since Feb 28th 2026).
This version is functionally identical to 1.2, which still supports old Firefox versions, if required.
